explanation: Enter the name of the tool texture, followed by its description, this file will set that description globally
materials/tools_postprocess_volume.vmat: Used for Post Processing Volume entities, usually applied automatically by Hammer
materials/tools/toolsclip.vmat: General purpose clip, blocks players, physics objects, and NPCs, compiles into the physics mesh only
materials/tools/toolsgrenadeclip.vmat: Blocks grenades, use it to smooth out surfaces players might try to bounce grenades off of in order to make the bounce more predictable, will not block the explosion of the grenade
materials/tools/toolsplayerclip.vmat: Same as clip, but only blocks players
materials/tools/toolsnodraw.vmat: Nodraw is a material which interacts with physics and VIS, blocks bullets, but will not compile into a render mesh, so it is invisible and will not cast shadows
materials/tools/toolsnodraw_grate.vmat: Same as nodraw, but with 'grate' material properties
materials/tools/toolsnodraw_metal.vmat: Same as nodraw, but with 'metal' material properties
materials/tools/toolsnodraw_plastic.vmat: Same as nodraw, but with 'plastic' material properties
materials/tools/toolsnodraw_wood.vmat: Same as nodraw, but with 'wood' material properties
materials/tools/tools_cs_place.vmat: Used for env_cs_place entities, usually applied automatically by Hammer
materials/tools/audioblocker.vmat: Used to block sounds, DO NOT use in Counter-Strike, use toolsblocksound instead
materials/tools/toolsblocksound.vmat: Used to block sounds, part of SteamAudio, used on Counter-Strike Nuke to block sounds between the Bombsites
materials/tools/toolsblack.vmat: Pitch black texture, ignores fog or other effects
materials/tools/toolswhite.vmat: Max white texture, ignores fog or other effects
materials/tools/toolsinvisible.vmat: Same as a clip, but solid to bullets
materials/tools/toolsinvisibleladder_woo: A climbable ladder, with wooded climbing sounds
materials/tools/toolssolidblocklight.vma: Blocks static and dynamic light and also compiles into the physics mesh, will affect VIS
materials/tools/toolstrigger.vmat: Used for all trigger meshes, usually applied automatically by Hammer
materials/tools/toolslightmapres.vmat: Used to denote which parts of the map should have higher lightmap resolution, for a guide go here: Using Lightmap Player Space
materials/tools/visblocker.vmat: Blocks VIS, will not be compiled into the finished map, it will only interact with VIS
materials/tools/toolsskybox.vmat: Used for sealing the level, blocks VIS, the VIS clusters near it will have reduced resolution
materials/tools/wrongway.vmat: Used to denote a blocked path, previously used in Counter-Strike Wingman
